title: Strong electron push–pull effect and low transition barrier boosting non-metallic COFs photoelectrode for ultrahigh-rate photo-assisted Li–air batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01403H, Paper
Yixin Zhou, Qinglong Jing, Xiaoru Zhang, Xuexia He, Jie Sun, Ruibin Jiang, Zhibin Lei, Fujun Li, Qi Li, Zong-Huai Liu
D–A type COFs with strong electron push–pull effect, low transition barrier, and robust built-in electric field were synthesized for photo-assisted Li–Air batteries, exhibiting superior round-trip efficiency, rate capability, and durability.
